message.content: Based on the discussion, RexxarRemar expressed interest in having a variety of colors in the garden. He suggested Camellias, which he thought would look nice alongside other flowers. RexxarRemar emphasized the importance of diversity in the garden palette, as he mentioned that having a range of colors would contribute to a visually appealing and vibrant environment.
